text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: ap-northeast GPU pressure spike detected (queue depth > 1200, 95th latency > 1.2s). Elevated 503 rate from inference-proxy-aze-01. Auto-fallback triggered for some customers.

maya (oncall): I'm on it. pulling grafana now.

maya (oncall): @ops-bot can you surface current pool utilization by GPU type and zone?

ops-bot: active_pools: [ap-ne-1-gpu-pool-A: 92% (v100), ap-ne-1-gpu-pool-B: 96% (a100), ap-ne-2-gpu-pool-C: 40%], pending_provision: 0, autoscale_events_last_15m: 5

rajiv: hit the dashboard too — looks like a steady ramp from a single tenant batch job plus a sudden burst of user traffic.

samira: @maya any customer-facing errors? CS reported a handful of 503s, need impact list.

maya (oncall): grabbing trace sample. top offender: tenant-id=customer-rp (heavy embedding churn). Partial fallbacks to eu-west.

laura-eng: can we throttle embeddings for that tenant temporarily or route them to a cheaper model?

maya (oncall): thinking: quick options — 1) spin reserved capacity in ap-ne, 2) scale up a100 pool w/ burst capacity, 3) apply per-tenant rate limit. I can push (3) now.

ash-product: pls confirm customer impact before throttling. Tom from CS is looped in.

tom-cs: we flagged 6 customers with >1% error rate in last 10m, listing in the ticket. Need an email if we throttle.

maya (oncall): ok applying per-tenant soft-limit for customer-rp at 60rps to reduce KV churn. Command: ```redwoodctl rate-limit set --tenant customer-rp --type soft --rps 60 --duration 10m```

ops-bot: rate-limit applied, TTL 600s.

maya (oncall): latency dropping on proxy 95th from 1.2s -> 0.85s in 90s. queue depth falling.

rajiv: we still need longer-term fix. autoscaler didn't provision as expected; looks like node boot failures in ap-ne-1 due to image pull timeout.

laura-eng: opening quick repro of node bootstrap logs. snippet: 
```kubelet: failed to pull image redwood-runtime:release-2026-02-18 context deadline exceeded
systemd: unit docker.service failed: failed to start
```

laura-eng: suspect transient registry throttle + startup script ordering causing retries to exceed timeout.

maya (oncall): thanks. primary mitigation done. Customer 503s down to baseline. I will escalate to infra for root cause and remediation.

ash-product: schedule post-incident sync and notify Tier2 agreement owners. Need a single thread for follow-ups.

samira: creating JIRA INFRA-2345 and linking to this incident. Short description: "ap-ne node bootstrap failures causing autoscaler shortfall during GPU surge".

samira: JIRA INFRA-2345 created: https://jira.redwood/infr/INFRA-2345 - assigned to laura-eng, priority P1.

laura-eng: ack. I'll investigate registry/backoff and add remediation plan. First quick wins: increase image pull timeout to 5m, add retries with backoff to startup script, and pre-pull images on scale-up.

rajiv: we should also add a fallback policy in routing layer to prefer eu-west when ap-ne nodes are degraded, rather than triggering full fallback that splits requests. That would reduce customer-visible errors.

maya (oncall): agree. add routing-policy ticket INFRA-2346.

ops-bot: INFRA-2346 created: "routing graceful diversion for ap-ne degraded nodes" assigned to rajiv.

ash-product: schedule postmortem — propose 2026-03-18 10:00 UTC. I'll send calendar invite with stakeholders: eng-runtime, eng-sre, product, cs.

tom-cs: please include the customer impact spreadsheet and list of affected customers so we can coordinate outbound comms if needed.

maya (oncall): compiling impact matrix now: 
- affected_customers: [customer-rp, customer-hk, customer-smb-12]
- peak_503_window: 2026-03-17T02:14:00Z - 2026-03-17T02:24:30Z
- mitigation: per-tenant soft limit, temporary routing to eu-west, manual restart of failed node boots

samira: putting action items here for clarity:
1) laura-eng: investigate image pull failures, implement pre-pull + backoff, due EOD 2026-03-18. (INFRA-2345)
2) rajiv: implement routing graceful diversion and add canary config, due 2026-03-22. (INFRA-2346)
3) maya (oncall): prepare incident timeline and monitoring thresholds for postmortem, due 2026-03-18.
4) ash-product: draft customer note for affected mid-market customers, coordinate with tom-cs, due 2026-03-19.
5) ops-bot: add autoscaler healthcheck alert for node bootstrap failures (new alert: autoscaler.node_bootstrap_fail_rate > 3 in 10m).

ops-bot: alert rule created: autoscaler.node_bootstrap_fail_rate > 3 in 10m -> paging to eng-ml oncall.

maya (oncall): creating follow-up thread for remediation tracking after postmortem. Putting a short summary in #incidents.

ash-product: thanks all. closing active bridge. please update JIRA tickets with logs and the mitigation commands used.

laura-eng: quick note — I'll add a small experiment to pre-pull images on scheduled autoscaler events; rollout on canary pool tomorrow.

rajiv: also adding a runbook step to prefer regional fallback order [local->nearby->global] when pool_health < 80%.

tom-cs: we'll hold off outbound comms until postmortem confirms root cause. keep me posted.

maya (oncall): final: incident resolved status. root cause candidate: registry rate limit + startup script race causing node boot timeouts, which blocked autoscaler from meeting demand. Postmortem scheduled 2026-03-18 10:00 UTC.

incidents-bot: Incident closed by maya (oncall). thread archived."
